candidates.change_summary: Change the argument offset from 0x0 to 0x14 so that owner() returns the collateral address instead.
Change the argument offset from 0x0 to 0x28 so that owner() returns the debt address instead.
Change the argument offset from 0x0 to 0x3c so that owner() returns the factory address instead.
Replace address(_getArgAddress(0x14)) with address(_getArgAddress(0x15)) to read from a different immutable arg offset, returning a different ERC20 address.
Replace address(_getArgAddress(0x14)) with address(_getArgAddress(0x28)) so collateral returns the debt token address instead.
Replace address(_getArgAddress(0x14)) with address(_getArgAddress(0x0)) so collateral returns the owner address as ERC20.
Replace address(_getArgAddress(0x14)) with address(_getArgAddress(0x3c)) so collateral returns the factory address as ERC20.
Replace address(_getArgAddress(0x14)) with msg.sender cast to address, making collateral return the caller instead of the immutable collateral token.
Replace address(_getArgAddress(0x14)) with address(this) cast to address, making collateral return the contract's own address.
